import math
import hashlib


class BloomFilter:
    def __init__(self, n: int, fp_rate: float):
        if n <= 0:
            raise ValueError("n must be > 0")
        if not (0 < fp_rate < 1):
            raise ValueError("fp_rate must be in (0, 1)")

        ln2 = math.log(2)
        ln2_sq = ln2 * ln2
        m = math.ceil(-(n * math.log(fp_rate)) / ln2_sq)
        k = max(1, round((m / n) * ln2))

        self.num_bits = m
        self.num_hashes = k
        self._bits = bytearray((m + 7) // 8)

    def add(self, item: str) -> None:
        item_bytes = item.encode('utf-8')
        for i in range(self.num_hashes):
            h = hashlib.sha256(item_bytes + str(i).encode('utf-8')).digest()
            bit_idx = int.from_bytes(h, 'big') % self.num_bits
            byte_idx = bit_idx >> 3
            bit_offset = bit_idx & 7
            self._bits[byte_idx] |= (1 << bit_offset)

    def __contains__(self, item: str) -> bool:
        item_bytes = item.encode('utf-8')
        for i in range(self.num_hashes):
            h = hashlib.sha256(item_bytes + str(i).encode('utf-8')).digest()
            bit_idx = int.from_bytes(h, 'big') % self.num_bits
            byte_idx = bit_idx >> 3
            bit_offset = bit_idx & 7
            if not (self._bits[byte_idx] & (1 << bit_offset)):
                return False
        return True
